entities.summary: Oral Armstrong Lincoln Selkridge, RA, LEED AP is a former sprinter from Antigua and Barbuda. He competed in the men's 4 × 400 metres relay at the 1988 Summer Olympics. Selkridge now works as an architect in New York City.
